raised.$description: --raised. Ground of floating panels: popover, menu, dialog, sheet, toast.

inverse.$description: --inverse. The one ink card that may anchor a group.

accent.$description: --accent. The one loud colour: the primary action, and at most one large surface per screen.

leaf.$description: --leaf. The single surface about where a product comes from.

scrim.$description: --scrim. The veil behind a dialog, drawer or sheet.

ink.$description: --ink. Primary text on page, surface, raised and leaf; selected states; the focus ring.

ink-soft.$description: --ink-soft. Secondary text on page, surface, raised and leaf.

ink-muted.$description: --ink-muted. Captions and hints on page, surface, raised and leaf.

ink-hint.$description: --ink-hint. The lightest text: axis ticks and placeholders on page, surface and raised (4.5:1 or more).

on-accent.$description: --on-accent. All text and icons on accent (12.9:1).

on-inverse.$description: --on-inverse. Primary text on inverse (14:1 or more).

on-dark-soft.$description: --on-dark-soft. Secondary text on inverse (8.5:1 or more).

on-dark-muted.$description: --on-dark-muted. Axis ticks and captions on inverse (5.9:1 or more).

on-dark-danger.$description: --on-dark-danger. Error text and the danger fill on the ink card, where danger is too dark to read.

on-dark-success.$description: --on-dark-success. Success text on the ink card, where success is too dark to read.

on-dark-code-comment.$description: --on-dark-code-comment. Comments, in a code block on the ink card.

on-dark-code-keyword.$description: --on-dark-code-keyword. Keywords and types (const, return, <!DOCTYPE>), in a code block on the ink card.

on-dark-code-string.$description: --on-dark-code-string. Strings, and the values of HTML attributes, in a code block on the ink card.

on-dark-code-function.$description: --on-dark-code-function. The names of functions and classes, in a code block on the ink card.

on-dark-code-tag.$description: --on-dark-code-tag. HTML tag names and CSS element selectors, in a code block on the ink card.

on-dark-code-constant.$description: --on-dark-code-constant. Attribute names, CSS properties and classes, numbers and literals, in a code block on the ink card.

on-dark-code-variable.$description: --on-dark-code-variable. Built-in names (document, console), in a code block on the ink card.

on-danger.$description: --on-danger. Text on a danger fill, such as the destructive button (6.5:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

hairline.$description: --hairline. The one rule colour: list dividers, table rows, form sections, chart gridlines.

rule-strong.$description: --rule-strong. A chart baseline, and the grip of a resizable split or a drawer.

track.$description: --track. The empty part of a meter, slider or progress bar; an inactive status chip; a skeleton.

control-off.$description: --control-off. An unselected radio ring or checkbox edge, and an off switch, on page and surface (3.1:1 or more).

inverse-off.$description: --inverse-off. An inactive mark or chip on inverse, with on-inverse text.

danger.$description: --danger. Error text, the 2px ring of an invalid field, the destructive button.

success.$description: --success. A positive change or a finished step, always with words or an icon.

code-comment.$description: --code-comment. Comments, in a code block on page and surface.

code-keyword.$description: --code-keyword. Keywords and types (const, return, <!DOCTYPE>), in a code block on page and surface.

code-string.$description: --code-string. Strings, and the values of HTML attributes, in a code block on page and surface.

code-function.$description: --code-function. The names of functions and classes, in a code block on page and surface.

code-tag.$description: --code-tag. HTML tag names and CSS element selectors, in a code block on page and surface.

code-constant.$description: --code-constant. Attribute names, CSS properties and classes, numbers and literals, in a code block on page and surface.

code-variable.$description: --code-variable. Built-in names (document, console), in a code block on page and surface.

paper.$description: --paper. The light page under a fixed name: controls on accent surfaces and the fills of drawings.

paper-ink.$description: --paper-ink. The light ink under a fixed name: text and strokes on accent surfaces and in drawings.

paper-tray.$description: --paper-tray. The light surface under a fixed name, on accent surfaces.

paper-soft.$description: --paper-soft. The light ink-soft under a fixed name.

paper-muted.$description: --paper-muted. The light ink-muted under a fixed name.

paper-hairline.$description: --paper-hairline. The light hairline under a fixed name.

paper-track.$description: --paper-track. The light track under a fixed name; the shaded side of a drawn object.

paper-danger.$description: --paper-danger. Error text and the danger fill on the yellow card, in every theme.

paper-success.$description: --paper-success. Success text on the yellow card, in every theme.

paper-code-comment.$description: --paper-code-comment. Comments, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

paper-code-keyword.$description: --paper-code-keyword. Keywords and types (const, return, <!DOCTYPE>), in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

paper-code-string.$description: --paper-code-string. Strings, and the values of HTML attributes, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

paper-code-function.$description: --paper-code-function. The names of functions and classes, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

paper-code-tag.$description: --paper-code-tag. HTML tag names and CSS element selectors, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

paper-code-constant.$description: --paper-code-constant. Attribute names, CSS properties and classes, numbers and literals, in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.

paper-code-variable.$description: --paper-code-variable. Built-in names (document, console), in a code block on the yellow card, in every theme.
